Consumer finance

Installment loans at the points of sale will make
your shopping experience quick and hassle-free

See list of partners

What is consumer finance?

We offer a quick and convenient option for purchasing household appliances, computer equipment, smartphones, mobile devices, furniture, and other goods for everyday life. Now, you can buy goods by obtaining an installment loan directly in the store1just in a few minutes, without visiting the Bank.


1 You may buy goods on installment plan only in select stores partnering with the bank.

What documents are needed to apply for an installment purchase?

To make a purchase on installment, take your identification document and social card or identification card with you when going to the store.

What payment methods can I use to repay the loan for a purchase made on installment?

After making a purchase on installment through Ameriabank, you can make regular repayments and other relevant payments using the most convenient methods for you: via payment terminals, money transfer from other banks, at our bank branches, and of course through Ameriabank’s online system on the Bank’s website.

Who can use the offered installment option?

Installment financing is available for resident individuals aged 20 to 66, both with and without citizenship of the Republic of Armenia.

What products can I purchase through installment?

Products eligible for installment financing include household and computer equipment, smartphones, solar systems, furniture, and more.

How is the payable amount transferred in case of an installment purchase?

The approved installment financing amount is transferred to the store in non-cash form based on your instruction as stipulated in the contract.

How is the financing decision made?

The decision on installment financing, the maximum loan amount, as well as the grounds for rejection, are determined through assessment of the customer's creditworthiness.


Grounds for rejecting installment financing may include:

a) poor credit history,

b) unreliable information provided.

Can I cancel the installment?

Yes, within 7 (seven) working days (unless a longer period is specified in the contract), you can cancel the provided financing without any justification by unilaterally terminating the contract.

In that case, the buyer is obliged to pay the lender interest for the use of the credit amount, which is calculated based on the annual effective interest rate specified in the credit agreement.

No other compensation is provided for termination of the financing contract.

CREDIT HISTORY AND CREDIT SCORE SUMMARY (SCORE) INFORMATION

This document presents the information required by RA legislation regarding credit history and credit score summary (score), the factors affecting it, and their use in the lending process by Ameriabank CJSC (hereinafter referred to as the "Bank").

Credit history is the information created/processed by a credit bureau regarding a customer's financial obligations, reflecting the customer's debts, payments, payment habits, and the dynamics/history of this information.

Credit history includes, in particular, the identification data of the customer, the amount of each obligation, annual interest rate, outstanding balance, payment frequency and due dates, delays in payments, guarantees provided for third parties, depersonalized information about obligations of related parties, as well as data on inquiries made about the credit history.

As a rule, credit history is used by financial institutions to assess a customer's ability to assume/maintain financial obligations, act as a guarantor, evaluate lending opportunities either at the initiative of the customer or the Bank, or provide loan offers to the customer.

Based on the customer's consent, the Bank submits an inquiry to ACRA Credit Reporting. Credit history information is reflected in a credit report that contains the customer's credit history for the previous 5 years as of the date of inquiry.

The customer can review their credit history at http://www.acra.am/.

The credit score is a numerical evaluation of the customer's creditworthiness and reliability.

The Bank uses its own creditworthiness and reliability evaluation system for lending purposes, with the main influencing factors listed below:

  • Credit history: The number and amount of active loans, frequency of loan applications, and a positive credit history (no delays, high-quality servicing) can help improve the score and lead to loan approval. A poor credit history (delays, long-term delinquencies) may lower the score and result in rejection or stricter conditions.
  • Employment, income, and work experience: Having stable employment/income can increase the score and lead to approval. Unstable or irregular income/employment may lower the score and lead to rejection or stricter terms.
  • Credit burden: A high debt-to-income ratio can negatively impact the score, while a low credit burden can help improve the score and lead to approval.
  • FICO Score: A FICO score is a statistical scoring model based on credit history used globally to assess credit risk. Details at acra.am.
  • Other information characterizing the customer

The importance of credit history and score

Credit history and credit score play a critical role in the decision-making process for loan approval, allowing banks and credit organizations to assess the level of credit risk and predict the customer’s likelihood of proper repayment.

Incorrect or incomplete credit history

If the credit history contains errors or incomplete data, the customer may apply to ACRA Credit Reporting CJSC (credit bureau) or the financial organization that provided the incorrect data.

For inquiries to ACRA Credit Reporting CJSC, the procedure and detailed description are available at acra.am.

If the incorrect or incomplete data was transferred by the Bank, the customer may submit a request via any of the following methods:

  • By emailing the Bank’s official email address
  • By calling the Bank at 010/012 561111
  • By sending a message via the Bank’s Internet/Mobile Banking system
  • By submitting a written application at any branch of the Bank

The Bank processes the customer's request in accordance with the RA legislation and/or internal legal regulations of the Bank, within the defined timeframes.

Steps to improve credit history and credit score

To improve credit history and score, it is necessary to eliminate the root causes as soon as possible, particularly:

  • Make regular loan payments according to the schedule, avoiding even a single day’s delay
  • Reduce the number and amount of guarantees provided; if possible, ensure repayment of overdue guaranteed obligations
  • Ease the credit burden by paying off overdue obligations
  • Avoid frequent applications for new loans, as credit history inquiries (except those for loan monitoring) may negatively impact the score

More detailed information about credit history (including errors or incompleteness) and/or credit score can be found at the respective sections of the following websites:

**What documents are needed to apply for an installment purchase?**

To make a purchase on installment, take your identification document and social card or identification card with you when going to the store.

**What payment methods can I use to repay the loan for a purchase made on installment?**

After making a purchase on installment through Ameriabank, you can make regular repayments and other relevant payments using the most convenient methods for you: via payment terminals, money transfer from other banks, at our bank branches, and of course through Ameriabank’s online system on the Bank’s website.

**Who can use the offered installment option?**

Installment financing is available for resident individuals aged 20 to 66, both with and without citizenship of the Republic of Armenia.

**What products can I purchase through installment?**

Products eligible for installment financing include household and computer equipment, smartphones, solar systems, furniture, and more.

**How is the payable amount transferred in case of an installment purchase?**

The approved installment financing amount is transferred to the store in non-cash form based on your instruction as stipulated in the contract.

**How is the financing decision made?**

The decision on installment financing, the maximum loan amount, as well as the grounds for rejection, are determined through assessment of the customer's creditworthiness.

Grounds for rejecting installment financing may include:

a) poor credit history,

b) unreliable information provided.

**Can I cancel the installment?**

Yes, within 7 (seven) working days (unless a longer period is specified in the contract), you can cancel the provided financing without any justification by unilaterally terminating the contract.

In that case, the buyer is obliged to pay the lender interest for the use of the credit amount, which is calculated based on the annual effective interest rate specified in the credit agreement.

No other compensation is provided for termination of the financing contract.

CREDIT HISTORY AND CREDIT SCORE SUMMARY (SCORE) INFORMATION

This document presents the information required by RA legislation regarding credit history and credit score summary (score), the factors affecting it, and their use in the lending process by Ameriabank CJSC (hereinafter referred to as the "Bank").

Credit history is the information created/processed by a credit bureau regarding a customer's financial obligations, reflecting the customer's debts, payments, payment habits, and the dynamics/history of this information.

Credit history includes, in particular, the identification data of the customer, the amount of each obligation, annual interest rate, outstanding balance, payment frequency and due dates, delays in payments, guarantees provided for third parties, depersonalized information about obligations of related parties, as well as data on inquiries made about the credit history.

As a rule, credit history is used by financial institutions to assess a customer's ability to assume/maintain financial obligations, act as a guarantor, evaluate lending opportunities either at the initiative of the customer or the Bank, or provide loan offers to the customer.

Based on the customer's consent, the Bank submits an inquiry to ACRA Credit Reporting. Credit history information is reflected in a credit report that contains the customer's credit history for the previous 5 years as of the date of inquiry.

The customer can review their credit history at [http://www.acra.am/](<http://www.acra.am/>).

The credit score is a numerical evaluation of the customer's creditworthiness and reliability.

The Bank uses its own creditworthiness and reliability evaluation system for lending purposes, with the main influencing factors listed below:

- Credit history: The number and amount of active loans, frequency of loan applications, and a positive credit history (no delays, high-quality servicing) can help improve the score and lead to loan approval. A poor credit history (delays, long-term delinquencies) may lower the score and result in rejection or stricter conditions.

- Employment, income, and work experience: Having stable employment/income can increase the score and lead to approval. Unstable or irregular income/employment may lower the score and lead to rejection or stricter terms.

- Credit burden: A high debt-to-income ratio can negatively impact the score, while a low credit burden can help improve the score and lead to approval.

- FICO Score: A FICO score is a statistical scoring model based on credit history used globally to assess credit risk. Details at [acra.am](<https://acra.am/%d5%bd%d6%84%d5%b8%d6%80/>).

- Other information characterizing the customer

The importance of credit history and score

Credit history and credit score play a critical role in the decision-making process for loan approval, allowing banks and credit organizations to assess the level of credit risk and predict the customer’s likelihood of proper repayment.

Incorrect or incomplete credit history

If the credit history contains errors or incomplete data, the customer may apply to ACRA Credit Reporting CJSC (credit bureau) or the financial organization that provided the incorrect data.

For inquiries to ACRA Credit Reporting CJSC, the procedure and detailed description are available at [acra.am](<https://acra.am/%d5%af%d5%a1%d5%ba-%d6%87-%d5%a1%d5%bb%d5%a1%d5%af%d6%81%d5%b8%d6%82%d5%a9%d5%b5%d5%b8%d6%82%d5%b6/%d5%b0%d5%a1%d5%b3%d5%a1%d5%ad%d5%b8%d6%80%d5%a4%d5%ab-%d5%ab%d6%80%d5%a1%d5%be%d5%b8%d6%82%d5%b6%d6%84%d5%b6%d5%a5%d6%80/>).

If the incorrect or incomplete data was transferred by the Bank, the customer may submit a request via any of the following methods:

- By emailing the Bank’s official email address

- By calling the Bank at 010/012 561111

- By sending a message via the Bank’s Internet/Mobile Banking system

- By submitting a written application at any branch of the Bank

The Bank processes the customer's request in accordance with the RA legislation and/or internal legal regulations of the Bank, within the defined timeframes.

Steps to improve credit history and credit score

To improve credit history and score, it is necessary to eliminate the root causes as soon as possible, particularly:

- Make regular loan payments according to the schedule, avoiding even a single day’s delay

- Reduce the number and amount of guarantees provided; if possible, ensure repayment of overdue guaranteed obligations

- Ease the credit burden by paying off overdue obligations

- Avoid frequent applications for new loans, as credit history inquiries (except those for loan monitoring) may negatively impact the score

blocks.text: CREDIT HISTORY AND CREDIT SCORE SUMMARY (SCORE) INFORMATION
blocks.markdown: CREDIT HISTORY AND CREDIT SCORE SUMMARY (SCORE) INFORMATION

blocks.text: This document presents the information required by RA legislation regarding credit history and credit score summary (score), the factors affecting it, and their use in the lending process by Ameriabank CJSC (hereinafter referred to as the "Bank").
blocks.markdown: This document presents the information required by RA legislation regarding credit history and credit score summary (score), the factors affecting it, and their use in the lending process by Ameriabank CJSC (hereinafter referred to as the "Bank").

blocks.text: Credit history is the information created/processed by a credit bureau regarding a customer's financial obligations, reflecting the customer's debts, payments, payment habits, and the dynamics/history of this information.
blocks.markdown: Credit history is the information created/processed by a credit bureau regarding a customer's financial obligations, reflecting the customer's debts, payments, payment habits, and the dynamics/history of this information.

blocks.text: Credit history includes, in particular, the identification data of the customer, the amount of each obligation, annual interest rate, outstanding balance, payment frequency and due dates, delays in payments, guarantees provided for third parties, depersonalized information about obligations of related parties, as well as data on inquiries made about the credit history.
blocks.markdown: Credit history includes, in particular, the identification data of the customer, the amount of each obligation, annual interest rate, outstanding balance, payment frequency and due dates, delays in payments, guarantees provided for third parties, depersonalized information about obligations of related parties, as well as data on inquiries made about the credit history.

blocks.text: As a rule, credit history is used by financial institutions to assess a customer's ability to assume/maintain financial obligations, act as a guarantor, evaluate lending opportunities either at the initiative of the customer or the Bank, or provide loan offers to the customer.
blocks.markdown: As a rule, credit history is used by financial institutions to assess a customer's ability to assume/maintain financial obligations, act as a guarantor, evaluate lending opportunities either at the initiative of the customer or the Bank, or provide loan offers to the customer.

blocks.text: Based on the customer's consent, the Bank submits an inquiry to ACRA Credit Reporting. Credit history information is reflected in a credit report that contains the customer's credit history for the previous 5 years as of the date of inquiry.
blocks.markdown: Based on the customer's consent, the Bank submits an inquiry to ACRA Credit Reporting. Credit history information is reflected in a credit report that contains the customer's credit history for the previous 5 years as of the date of inquiry.

blocks.text: The customer can review their credit history at http://www.acra.am/.
blocks.markdown: The customer can review their credit history at [http://www.acra.am/](<http://www.acra.am/>).

blocks.text: The credit score is a numerical evaluation of the customer's creditworthiness and reliability.
blocks.markdown: The credit score is a numerical evaluation of the customer's creditworthiness and reliability.

blocks.text: The Bank uses its own creditworthiness and reliability evaluation system for lending purposes, with the main influencing factors listed below:
blocks.markdown: The Bank uses its own creditworthiness and reliability evaluation system for lending purposes, with the main influencing factors listed below:

blocks.text: Credit history: The number and amount of active loans, frequency of loan applications, and a positive credit history (no delays, high-quality servicing) can help improve the score and lead to loan approval. A poor credit history (delays, long-term delinquencies) may lower the score and result in rejection or stricter conditions.
blocks.markdown: Credit history: The number and amount of active loans, frequency of loan applications, and a positive credit history (no delays, high-quality servicing) can help improve the score and lead to loan approval. A poor credit history (delays, long-term delinquencies) may lower the score and result in rejection or stricter conditions.

blocks.text: Employment, income, and work experience: Having stable employment/income can increase the score and lead to approval. Unstable or irregular income/employment may lower the score and lead to rejection or stricter terms.
blocks.markdown: Employment, income, and work experience: Having stable employment/income can increase the score and lead to approval. Unstable or irregular income/employment may lower the score and lead to rejection or stricter terms.

blocks.text: Credit burden: A high debt-to-income ratio can negatively impact the score, while a low credit burden can help improve the score and lead to approval.
blocks.markdown: Credit burden: A high debt-to-income ratio can negatively impact the score, while a low credit burden can help improve the score and lead to approval.

blocks.text: FICO Score: A FICO score is a statistical scoring model based on credit history used globally to assess credit risk. Details at acra.am.
blocks.markdown: FICO Score: A FICO score is a statistical scoring model based on credit history used globally to assess credit risk. Details at [acra.am](<https://acra.am/%d5%bd%d6%84%d5%b8%d6%80/>).

blocks.text: The importance of credit history and score
blocks.markdown: The importance of credit history and score

blocks.text: Credit history and credit score play a critical role in the decision-making process for loan approval, allowing banks and credit organizations to assess the level of credit risk and predict the customer’s likelihood of proper repayment.
blocks.markdown: Credit history and credit score play a critical role in the decision-making process for loan approval, allowing banks and credit organizations to assess the level of credit risk and predict the customer’s likelihood of proper repayment.

blocks.text: If the credit history contains errors or incomplete data, the customer may apply to ACRA Credit Reporting CJSC (credit bureau) or the financial organization that provided the incorrect data.
blocks.markdown: If the credit history contains errors or incomplete data, the customer may apply to ACRA Credit Reporting CJSC (credit bureau) or the financial organization that provided the incorrect data.

blocks.text: For inquiries to ACRA Credit Reporting CJSC, the procedure and detailed description are available at acra.am.
blocks.markdown: For inquiries to ACRA Credit Reporting CJSC, the procedure and detailed description are available at [acra.am](<https://acra.am/%d5%af%d5%a1%d5%ba-%d6%87-%d5%a1%d5%bb%d5%a1%d5%af%d6%81%d5%b8%d6%82%d5%a9%d5%b5%d5%b8%d6%82%d5%b6/%d5%b0%d5%a1%d5%b3%d5%a1%d5%ad%d5%b8%d6%80%d5%a4%d5%ab-%d5%ab%d6%80%d5%a1%d5%be%d5%b8%d6%82%d5%b6%d6%84%d5%b6%d5%a5%d6%80/>).

blocks.text: Steps to improve credit history and credit score
blocks.markdown: Steps to improve credit history and credit score

blocks.text: To improve credit history and score, it is necessary to eliminate the root causes as soon as possible, particularly:
blocks.markdown: To improve credit history and score, it is necessary to eliminate the root causes as soon as possible, particularly:

blocks.text: Make regular loan payments according to the schedule, avoiding even a single day’s delay
blocks.markdown: Make regular loan payments according to the schedule, avoiding even a single day’s delay

blocks.text: Reduce the number and amount of guarantees provided; if possible, ensure repayment of overdue guaranteed obligations
blocks.markdown: Reduce the number and amount of guarantees provided; if possible, ensure repayment of overdue guaranteed obligations

blocks.text: Ease the credit burden by paying off overdue obligations
blocks.markdown: Ease the credit burden by paying off overdue obligations

blocks.text: Avoid frequent applications for new loans, as credit history inquiries (except those for loan monitoring) may negatively impact the score
blocks.markdown: Avoid frequent applications for new loans, as credit history inquiries (except those for loan monitoring) may negatively impact the score

SCORE SUMMARY (SCORE) INFORMATION</strong></p>\n<p>This document presents the information required by RA legislation regarding credit history and credit score summary (score), the factors affecting it, and their use in the lending process by Ameriabank CJSC (hereinafter referred to as the \"Bank\").</p>\n<p><strong>Credit history</strong> is the information created/processed by a credit bureau regarding a customer's financial obligations, reflecting the customer's debts, payments, payment habits, and the dynamics/history of this information.</p>\n<p>Credit history includes, in particular, the identification data of the customer, the amount of each obligation, annual interest rate, outstanding balance, payment frequency and due dates, delays in payments, guarantees provided for third parties, depersonalized information about obligations of related parties, as well as data on inquiries made about the credit history.</p>\n<p>As a rule, credit history is used by financial institutions to assess a customer's ability to assume/maintain financial obligations, act as a guarantor, evaluate lending opportunities either at the initiative of the customer or the Bank, or provide loan offers to the customer.</p>\n<p>Based on the customer's consent, the Bank submits an inquiry to ACRA Credit Reporting. Credit history information is reflected in a credit report that contains the customer's credit history for the previous 5 years as of the date of inquiry.</p>\n<p>The customer can review their credit history at <a href=\"http://www.acra.am/\">http://www.acra.am/</a>.</p>\n<p><strong>The credit score</strong> is a numerical evaluation of the customer's creditworthiness and reliability.</p>\n<p>The Bank uses its own creditworthiness and reliability evaluation system for lending purposes, with the main influencing factors listed below:</p>\n<ul>\n  <li><strong>Credit history:</strong> The number and amount of active loans, frequency of loan applications, and a positive credit history (no delays, high-quality servicing) can help improve the score and lead to loan approval. A poor credit history (delays, long-term delinquencies) may lower the score and result in rejection or stricter conditions.</li>\n  <li><strong>Employment, income, and work experience:</strong> Having stable employment/income can increase the score and lead to approval. Unstable or irregular income/employment may lower the score and lead to rejection or stricter terms.</li>\n  <li><strong>Credit burden:</strong> A high debt-to-income ratio can negatively impact the score, while a low credit burden can help improve the score and lead to approval.</li>\n  <li><strong>FICO Score:</strong> A FICO score is a statistical scoring model based on credit history used globally to assess credit risk. Details at <a href=\"https://acra.am/%d5%bd%d6%84%d5%b8%d6%80/\">acra.am</a>.</li>\n  <li><strong>Other information characterizing the customer</strong></li>\n</ul>\n<p><strong>The importance of credit history and score</strong></p>\n<p>Credit history and credit score play a critical role in the decision-making process for loan approval, allowing banks and credit organizations to assess the level of credit risk and predict the customer’s likelihood of proper repayment.</p>\n<p><strong>Incorrect or incomplete credit history</strong></p>\n<p>If the credit history contains errors or incomplete data, the customer may apply to ACRA Credit Reporting CJSC (credit bureau) or the financial organization that provided the incorrect data.</p>\n<p>For inquiries to ACRA Credit Reporting CJSC, the procedure and detailed description are available at <a href=\"https://acra.am/%d5%af%d5%a1%d5%ba-%d6%87-%d5%a1%d5%bb%d5%a1%d5%af%d6%81%d5%b8%d6%82%d5%a9%d5%b5%d5%b8%d6%82%d5%b6/%d5%b0%d5%a1%d5%b3%d5%a1%d5%ad%d5%b8%d6%80%d5%a4%d5%ab-%d5%ab%d6%80%d5%a1%d5%be%d5%b8%d6%82%d5%b6%d6%84%d5%b6%d5%a5%d6%80/\">acra.am</a>.</p>\n<p>If the incorrect or incomplete data was transferred by the Bank, the customer may submit a request via any of the following methods:</p>\n<ul>\n  <li>By emailing the Bank’s official email address</li>\n  <li>By calling the Bank at 010/012 561111</li>\n  <li>By sending a message via the Bank’s Internet/Mobile Banking system</li>\n  <li>By submitting a written application at any branch of the Bank</li>\n</ul>\n<p>The Bank processes the customer's request in accordance with the RA legislation and/or internal legal regulations of the Bank, within the defined timeframes.</p>\n<p><strong>Steps to improve credit history and credit score</strong></p>\n<p>To improve credit history and score, it is necessary to eliminate the root causes as soon as possible, particularly:</p>\n<ul>\n  <li>Make regular loan payments according to the schedule, avoiding even a single day’s delay</li>\n  <li>Reduce the number and amount of guarantees provided; if possible, ensure repayment of overdue guaranteed obligations</li>\n  <li>Ease the credit burden by paying off overdue obligations</li>\n  <li>Avoid frequent applications for new loans, as credit history inquiries (except those for loan monitoring) may negatively impact the score</li>\n</ul>\n<p>More detailed information about credit history (including errors or incompleteness) and/or credit score can be found at the respective sections of the following websites:</p>\n<ul>\n  <li><a href=\"https://acra.am/%d5%af%d5%a1%d5%ba-%d6%87-%d5%a1%d5%bb%d5%a1%d5%af%d6%81%d5%b8%d6%82%d5%a9%d5%b5%d5%b8%d6%82%d5%b6/%d5%b0-%d5%bf-%d5%b0/\">acra.am</a> – A poor credit history (delays, long-term delinquencies) may lower the score and result in rejection or stricter conditions.</li>\n  <li><strong>Employment, income, and work experience:</strong> Having stable employment/income can increase the score and lead to approval. Unstable or irregular income/employment may lower the score and lead to rejection or stricter terms.</li>\n  <li><strong>Credit burden:</strong> A high debt-to-income ratio can negatively impact the score, while a low credit burden can help improve the score and lead to approval.</li>\n  <li><strong>FICO Score:</strong> A FICO score is a statistical scoring model based on credit history used globally to assess credit risk. Details at <a href=\"https://acra.am/%d5%bd%d6%84%d5%b8%d6%80/\">acra.am</a>.</li>\n  <li><strong>Other information characterizing the customer</strong></li>\n</ul>\n<p><strong>The importance of credit history and score</strong></p>\n<p>Credit history and credit score play a critical role in the decision-making process for loan approval, allowing banks and credit organizations to assess the level of credit risk and predict the customer’s likelihood of proper repayment.</p>\n<p><strong>Incorrect or incomplete credit history</strong></p>\n<p>If the credit history contains errors or CJSC, the procedure and detailed description are available at <a href=\"https://acra.am/%d5%af%d5%a1%d5%ba-%d6%87-%d5%a1%d5%bb%d5%a1%d5%af%d6%81%d5%b8%d6%82%d5%a9%d5%b5%d5%b8%d6%82%d5%b6/%d5%b0%d5%a1%d5%b3%d5%a1%d5%ad%d5%b8%d6%80%d5%a4%d5%ab-%d5%ab%d6%80%d5%a1%d5%be%d5%b8%d6%82%d5%b6%d6%84%d5%b6%d5%a5%d6%80/\">acra.am</a>.</p>\n<p>If the incorrect or incomplete data was transferred by the Bank, the customer may submit a request via any of the following methods:</p>\n<ul>\n  <li>By emailing the Bank’s official email address</li>\n  <li>By calling the Bank at 010/012 561111</li>\n  <li>By sending a message via the Bank’s Internet/Mobile Banking system</li>\n  <li>By submitting a written application at any branch of the Bank</li>\n</ul>\n<p>The Bank processes the customer's request in accordance with the RA legislation and/or internal legal regulations of the Bank, within the defined timeframes.</p>\n<p><strong>Steps to improve credit history and credit score</strong></p>\n<p>To improve credit history and score, it is necessary to eliminate the root causes as soon as possible, particularly:</p>\n<ul>\n  <li>Make regular loan payments according to the schedule, avoiding even a single day’s delay</li>\n  <li>Reduce the number and amount of guarantees provided; if possible, ensure repayment of overdue guaranteed
